claims.text: The workspace (GET /api/case and the page at /) loads the case's statements and computes every figure through the figures layer via overrides.case_figures (profile and whole override log), showing per account the money-in breakdown (M2 with M18 within it, M19-M25, total M17, to the penny), all of M1-M28 and the monthly summary; the page renders them server-side in src/cma/review/summary.py, which does no money arithmetic.

R3: when the money-in buckets do not reconcile (a credit in no bucket, or a debit counted as trading receipts), in any account, the API and page show no figures for the case (no breakdown, figures or monthly table, for every account) and report the difference in pence and the lines involved (account, id, date, escaped description, amount, category). overrides.case_figures now attaches the account and categorised statement to the ReconciliationError it re-raises.

P8 on the workspace HTML: for 25 seeded random statements whose descriptions, label and business name mix markup, entities, script tags, comment markers and the page's own markers, the served page holds no tag or attribute the workspace does not write, holds each text only in escaped form, and a parser reads it back as the text itself; this holds both when figures are shown and when the reconciliation report lists a line's description. Removing escaping in summary._e makes 26 invariants tests fail.
Existing server, override and figures-layer tests still pass, and lint is clean.
claims.proof_cmd: python -m pytest -q tests/test_workspace_summary.py tests/test_review_server.py tests/test_overrides.py tests/test_money_in.py && ruff check src tests

notes: Commit d6fd5a2 on the T19 branch. Design choices: the summary is rendered into the page server-side (html.escape on every case text) so P8 is judged on the HTML the server sends; /api/case returns the same summary as JSON (application/json, nosniff). Descriptions appear in T19's view only in the reconciliation report; the per-line drill-down is T20, the queue and indicators T43, the policy panel T21. A case whose files are refused (broken or busy case log, a changed override log, a statement the loader refuses, an amount error) also shows no figures, with the refusal. Multi-account combination (R41) is T33: accounts are shown separately, and one account failing reconciliation hides all. The reconciliation tests force a credit out of every bucket by patching overrides.categorise, since no real categorisation path produces one. The full-suite run was taken just before a one-line wording change to a refusal message (period handling); the touched test files were re-run after it. models.money_exact was extracted from Metric.display_exact (same output) so monthly cells and line amounts show to the penny the same way.
